channel.title: News Today — Smart AI News Portal
channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: Sunday Premier League action features five fixtures
item.description: English football fans experienced a packed Sunday schedule featuring five Premier League matches. The day's lineup included a notable encounter between Liverpool and Brighton.

item.title: Serbian leader Vucic acknowledges defeat to student protesters
item.description: After twelve years in power, Serbia's right-wing populist leader admitted his party lost the crucial electoral contest. He stated it was obvious the ballot, viewed as a test for the nation's direction, resulted in defeat against the student-backed movement.

item.title: Bulgarian presidential race proceeds to second round
item.description: Voter participation remained low as Bulgaria's election advanced to a run-off. Voters will decide next week between Iliana Yotova and former caretaker prime minister Andrey Gyurov.

item.title: Australian Parliament convenes as members prepare to honor Helen Haines
item.description: Legislators gather in parliament to remember Helen Haines following an alleged incident. House Speaker Milton Dick plans to urge members to sign a new civility agreement today.

item.title: Brazil runoff ballot counting resumes following court extension
item.description: Following a two-hour voting extension mandated by the supreme court, polling stations in Brazil closed. Balloting updates continued as candidates Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva awaited the final outcome.

item.title: সৌদি আদালতে দুই বাংলাদেশির মৃত্যুদণ্ড ও 'তাজির' আইনের আলোচনা
item.description: শরিয়া আইনের 'তাজির' ধারায় দুই বাংলাদেশিকে দোষী সাব্যস্ত করে মৃত্যুদণ্ড দিয়েছে সৌদি আদালত। এর ফলে 'তাজির' ব্যবস্থার আওতায় সর্বোচ্চ সাজা দেওয়া যায় কি না, তা নিয়ে আলোচনা শুরু হয়েছে।

item.title: Northeast drug syndicate raids uncover Rs 270 crore in illegal deals
item.description: Law enforcement operations targeting narcotics syndicates in the northeast uncovered illegal transactions totaling Rs 270 crore. The illicit financial activities came to light during recent searches.

item.title: Serbia election challenges Vučić's rule
item.description: Serbian voters head to the polls as long-serving leader Aleksandar Vučić faces opposition from the Student List movement. Ipsos and Cesid estimate voter turnout at 60.8 percent amid ongoing anti-corruption protests.

item.title: Ross Smith claims second European Championship darts title
item.description: Ross Smith defeated local competitor Martin Schindler to secure his second European Championship trophy. The tournament concluded after world champion Luke Littler suffered a quarter-final elimination.

item.title: External Affairs Minister urges UN action during global emergencies
item.description: India's External Affairs Minister called on the United Nations to take active leadership roles during worldwide crises instead of remaining passive observers.

item.title: Maximizing your Windows workspace with neglected desktop tools
item.description: Windows includes a built-in feature designed to expand active workspace areas. Many computer operators frequently ignore this capability.

item.title: Real Madrid defeats Barcelona 2-1 at Camp Nou in La Liga
item.description: Kylian Mbappe netted two goals for Madrid, handing Barcelona their initial domestic loss of the season. The victory narrows the points gap behind the league leaders.

item.title: Israel prepares for a crucial election amid deep divisions
item.description: A pivotal national vote approaches in Israel following three years of regional conflict. The country faces this major political test amid significant internal division.

item.title: এমবাপ্পের দুই গোলে বার্সাকে হারাল রিয়াল মাদ্রিদ
item.description: লা লিগার ক্লাসিকো ম্যাচে বার্সেলোনাকে হারিয়েছে রিয়াল মাদ্রিদ। ফরাসি তারকা এমবাপ্পের দুই গোলে পয়েন্ট ব্যবধান কমিয়ে এনেছে মাদ্রিদের ক্লাবটি।

item.title: Major fire destroys dozens of shops near Jammu Railway Station
item.description: A large blaze broke out at Shiv Market close to the Jammu Railway Station. Between 35 and 40 commercial stores were completely destroyed by the flames.

item.title: Security and democracy dominate critical Israeli election
item.description: Israel's highly anticipated general election highlights security and democracy as key concerns. Middle East correspondent Lucy Williamson covers the major political event.

item.title: Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić concedes defeat after vote
item.description: A massive turnout driven by student protests appears to conclude Aleksandar Vučić's twelve-year governance. The long-term Serbian leader has acknowledged his electoral loss.

item.title: TSA regulations regarding AirTags in checked baggage
item.description: While airlines restrict certain batteries in checked bags, the regulations apply differently to compact cells like the ones used in tracking devices.

item.title: Former Calabasas property of John Stamos slashed to $6.4m
item.description: A Mediterranean residence in Calabasas previously owned by actor John Stamos has seen its market price reduced significantly. Originally listed close to $13 million following updates by its current owners, the property is now available for roughly $6.4 million.

item.title: Troy Deeney selects latest Premier League standout squad
item.description: Football analyst Troy Deeney reveals his personal selection of top-performing players following the latest round of Premier League fixtures. Fans are invited to evaluate and discuss his choices for the weekly team.

item.title: ডেন্টাল হাইজিনিস্ট থেকে শিল্পী, ফ্লোরিডায় উদ্যোক্তা হিসেবে এগিয়ে চলেছেন সন্দ্বীপের জাহান রিমা
item.description: Prothom Alo-এর প্রতিবেদন অনুযায়ী, বাংলাদেশের মেয়ে মাসুমা জাহান রিমা। পেশায় যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের একজন ডেন্টাল হাইজিনিস্ট। লেখক হিসেবে নিজেকে প্রকাশ করেছেন এক যুগের বেশি সময় আগে। শিল্পী হিসেবেও পরিচিতি গড়ে তুলেছেন অর্ধযুগ ধরে। এ ঘটনায় আলোচিত: হিসেবে, ডেন্টাল, হাইজিনিস্ট, শিল্পী।

item.title: Antonelli victorious in US race ahead of title decider
item.description: Driver Kimi Antonelli secured a clear victory at the United States Grand Prix. He now requires just two additional points to clinch his inaugural world championship.

item.title: Philadelphia Orchestra secures $10.5m donation for tours
item.description: David L. Cohen and Rhonda R. Cohen have pledged $10.5 million to the Philadelphia Orchestra. The funds will support global tours, international cultural exchanges, and the creation of contemporary musical works.

item.title: Indian Foreign Minister Jaishankar travels for US summits
item.description: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar is scheduled to participate in upcoming G20 and Quad ministerial gatherings in the United States.

item.title: Alternative uses for older generation Nest thermostats
item.description: Owners of first and second-generation Nest Learning Thermostats face decisions regarding the continued utility of their outdated devices. Various practical approaches can be taken instead of discarding the unsupported hardware.

item.title: Brazil 2026 runoff election features Lula against Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Following an unexpected initial loss, incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva competes in a runoff election against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: CBFC security breach compromises scripts and films
item.description: The Central Board of Film Certification experienced a data leak affecting confidential files and unreleased scripts for around 500 movies. This security failure has sparked worry among industry professionals regarding the safety of submitted materials.

item.title: Marine Le Pen Initiates French Presidential Bid
item.description: National Rally leader Marine Le Pen has kicked off her presidential bid amid widespread economic worries and public demonstrations, promising a national revival.

item.title: DOJ Official Todd Blanche Backs Alaska Senate Suit
item.description: US Justice Department official Todd Blanche has spoken out in support of the federal lawsuit regarding the Alaska Senate race, which critics claim seeks to halt a Democratic win.

item.title: Marine Le Pen Starts French Presidential Run
item.description: Politician Marine Le Pen has officially initiated her campaign for the French presidency.

item.title: Supreme Court Creamy Layer Case Won't Impact CSE-2025 Seniority
item.description: According to insiders, the ongoing creamy layer legal proceedings in the Supreme Court will not affect the ranking and seniority of the 2025 Civil Services Examination cohort.

item.title: Brazilian Vote Tally Continues After Polling Extension
item.description: Ballot counting is underway in Brazil following an extra two hours of voting. Observers anticipate an extremely tight outcome between conservative Jair Bolsonaro and leftist rival Lula.

item.title: RBI Governor Asserts Sovereignty of All Data Centers
item.description: The chief of the Reserve Bank of India stated that all data facilities will remain strictly sovereign.

item.title: California Congressional Districts Redrawn by Democrats
item.description: Democratic officials have altered electoral boundaries in California to challenge five congressional districts currently held by Republicans.

item.title: iFixit Dissects New iPhone Duo and Assesses Repairability
item.description: A teardown of the newest foldable iPhone by iFixit revealed mechanisms for concealing the screen crease and resulted in a five out of ten repair score.

item.title: Manchester United revives performance in Women's Super League
item.description: Manchester United has successfully reversed its poor run in the Women's Super League, showing a stark improvement compared to results from the previous month.

item.title: Grok unveils initial seven minutes from AI video project 'Odyssey'
item.description: An initial seven-minute preview of the artificial intelligence production 'Odyssey' has been made public by Grok. The clip offers an early look at the synthetic media project.

item.title: Artificial intelligence integrated into curriculum as NCERT prepares learning framework
item.description: The Central Board of Secondary Education has incorporated artificial intelligence into official classroom instruction. To support this initiative, the National Council of Educational Research and Training created dedicated instructional modules.

item.title: Incorrect Wi-Fi frequency allocation can reduce internet connection speeds
item.description: Modern wireless routers distribute signals across two or three distinct frequency channels. Selecting the appropriate frequency band for individual hardware is critical to maintaining optimal network performance.

item.title: Grange University Hospital defends safety record despite harsh public criticism
item.description: Despite online complaints describing Grange University Hospital as unsafe, facility leaders maintain it ranks among the nation's most secure medical centers. The institution previously received backlash concerning extended waiting times, high patient density, and inadequate personnel levels.

item.title: বিশ্ব অপেরা দিবসে সিডনি অপেরা হাউসে দর্শনার্থীদের উপচে পড়া ভিড়
item.description: ২৫ অক্টোবর আন্তর্জাতিক অপেরা দিবস উপলক্ষে অস্ট্রেলিয়ার সিডনি অপেরা হাউস প্রাঙ্গণে প্রচুর মানুষের সমাগম ঘটে। রবিবার ছুটির দিনে আগত দর্শনার্থীরা স্বজন ও বন্ধুদের সাথে নিয়ে সাংস্কৃতিক পরিবেশনা উপভোগের পাশাপাশি ছবি তুলে মুহূর্তগুলো স্মরণীয় করে রাখেন।

item.title: Election Commission denies RTI request on voter list verification software
item.description: The Election Commission of India turned down a Right to Information request regarding the program used to detect voter roll discrepancies. Filed by a Telangana activist, the petition was rejected after election officials cited intellectual property rights and trade secrecy protections.

item.title: Manchester United supporters back Michael Carrick during home loss to Bournemouth
item.description: During a three-goal defeat against Bournemouth at Old Trafford, Manchester United spectators audibly demonstrated allegiance to Michael Carrick. However, attending fans simultaneously voiced dissatisfaction regarding nearly all other management decisions.

item.title: ব্যবসায়ীকে জিম্মি করে ১০ লাখ টাকা দাবি: পুলিশি অভিযানে ৬ জন আটক
item.description: এক ব্যবসায়ীকে বন্দি করে ১০ লাখ টাকা মুক্তিপণ দাবির অভিযোগে ৬ জনকে গ্রেফতার করা হয়েছে। মামলার বিবরণ অনুযায়ী, অভিযুক্তদের হাত থেকে আত্মরক্ষা করতে ভুক্তভোগী ব্যক্তি তার কাছে থাকা মোটরসাইকেল ক্রয়ের ৭০ হাজার টাকা হস্তান্তর করতে বাধ্য হন।

item.title: Clayface Opens Strong at Box Office Along with Hit Documentary
item.description: DC Studios' Gotham villain movie Clayface debuted with $24 million. Meanwhile, A24's documentary You Can See Everything brought in $19.5 million during its initial wide launch, with both pictures earning favorable reviews.

item.title: Trump Labels El-Sayed a Jihadist and Alleges Family Ties at Rally
item.description: During a campaign event in Michigan, Donald Trump referred to El-Sayed as a jihadist and made claims connecting the individual's mother to Al-Qaeda.

item.title: Florida Approves Funding to Protect Hendrie Ranch Land
item.description: State authorities authorized a $12.9 million conservation easement to safeguard 5,610 acres of Hendrie Ranch. The accord prevents future development while permitting ongoing cattle farming and agricultural activities.

item.title: Fatal Bus Crash on Kenyan Highway Claims 24 Lives
item.description: At least 24 church mourners lost their lives in a collision along the Nairobi-Mombasa Highway in Kenya. The tragedy follows another recent traffic accident in the country that resulted in 17 fatalities.

item.title: Eddie Howe Open to Manchester United Discussions
item.description: Manager Eddie Howe would consider discussions with Manchester United if the club dismisses Michael Carrick. Additionally, three Premier League teams are currently tracking Bayern Munich player Lennart Karl.

item.title: Scott Walker Album The Drift Delivers Deeply Unsettling Sound
item.description: Scott Walker's album The Drift provides genuinely terrifying listening material. It stands apart from standard seasonal novelty tracks by offering an intensely unsettling musical experience.

item.title: RBI Research Shows Banks Raise Rates Faster Than They Cut Them
item.description: A Reserve Bank of India analysis reveals financial institutions implement 76.4% of repo rate hikes but transfer only 64% of rate cuts to customers. Lending costs climbed significantly during monetary tightening phases.

item.title: Australia Faces Squad Decisions Ahead of Green's Comeback
item.description: Australia's cricket squad faces major selection choices as players prepare for Green's return to the team. Analysts are debating which squad members will retain their spots and who might be dropped.

item.title: Justice Kaul Criticizes Ex-CJI Chandrachud Over Executive Deference
item.description: Retired Justice Sanjay Kishan Kaul stated that former Chief Justice D Y Chandrachud showed excessive accommodation toward the administration regarding judicial selections. He suggested this approach compromised institutional autonomy.

item.title: Schools Nationwide to Establish Supervised Medical Facilities
item.description: Authorities plan to introduce campus health stations offering initial care such as bandages and oral rehydration solutions. These facilities will operate under the care of trained personnel for temporary rest.

item.title: EPFO Evaluates 250 Billion Rupee Fund to Protect Interest Rates
item.description: The retirement fund body is reviewing plans for a 25-billion-rupee reserve to secure subscriber returns against market volatility and bond defaults. The proposed fund aims to maintain steady interest payouts.

item.title: Raj Thackeray Removes Modi-Adani Video Following Police Request
item.description: MNS leader Raj Thackeray took down a controversial documentary post after a request from the Mumbai police commissioner. However, he confirmed his ongoing opposition to corporate monopolies.

item.title: Serbian Leader Vucic Admits Loss Following Snap Election
item.description: Aleksandar Vucic acknowledged defeat after Sunday's snap ballot drew a turnout near 70 percent, the highest since 1992. The vote followed two years of youth-led protests against his administration.

item.title: Student-Led Movement Defeats Serbian Leader Vucic at Polls
item.description: In a major political upset, longtime Serbian ruler Aleksandar Vucic acknowledged loss to a youth-driven coalition during parliamentary voting.

item.title: এআই বিজনেস সামিট ঢাকায় ৫ নভেম্বর, শতাধিক স্টার্টআপের অংশ নেওয়ার কথা
item.description: আগামী ৫ নভেম্বর ঢাকায় বসছে এআই বিজনেস সামিট। এই সম্মেলনে তিন দিনব্যাপী বিশেষজ্ঞ আলোচনা এবং প্রায় একশ স্টার্টআপের উদ্ভাবনী প্রযুক্তি প্রদর্শনী অনুষ্ঠিত হবে।

item.title: Revived book publication critiques libertarian ideology in Silicon Valley
item.description: An author re-releases their publication criticizing tech libertarians, dismissing their worldview as outdated. The book has recently returned to circulation.
